Migration complete and verified. The exit code is just from killing the test server — every smoke test passed: page titles render via the Metadata API, the API handlers return the right payloads and status codes (including 400 validation, 405 for undefined methods, and 404 for unknown routes), and the build reproduces the original rendering semantics exactly (`/` dynamic, `/blog` ISR 60s, `/blog/[id]` with 10 prerendered paths revalidating every 5 minutes).

**What was migrated** — everything is now TypeScript with explicit types (`Post`/`Comment` interfaces live in `lib/types.ts`):

- `pages/_app.js` + `pages/_document.js` → `app/layout.tsx`. The `<Html>`/`<Main>`/`<NextScript>` document APIs don't exist in App Router, so the layout renders `<html>`/`<body>` directly; the description and favicon moved to the `metadata` export, and the Google Fonts `<link>` tags were replaced with `next/font/google` (the current pattern — it self-hosts Inter and removes the preconnect boilerplate).
- `pages/index.js` → `app/page.tsx`. `getServerSideProps` no longer exists; it's now an async server component using `await headers()` for the user agent, with `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` and `cache: 'no-store'` to keep per-request rendering.
- `pages/blog/index.js` → `app/blog/page.tsx` with `export const revalidate = 60` replacing `getStaticProps`' revalidate.
- `pages/blog/[id].js` → `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`. `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams` (first 10 posts), `fallback: 'blocking'` → `dynamicParams = true`, the `notFound: true` return → `notFound()` from `next/navigation`, per-post `<Head>` tags → `generateMetadata`, and the `router.isFallback` loading state → `app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx`. Note `params` is awaited, as required in Next 15+.
- `pages/404.js` → `app/not-found.tsx`; `pages/_error.js` → `app/error.tsx` + `app/global-error.tsx` (`getInitialProps` and the status-code prop don't exist in App Router — error boundaries receive `{ error, reset }`, and 404s route to `not-found.tsx`).
- API routes → route handlers at `app/api/posts/route.ts` and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` using `NextRequest`/`NextResponse` with async `params`. The manual 405 branches were dropped because App Router returns 405 automatically for methods without an exported handler (verified above).
- Client-side bits (`useRouter` from `next/router`, which is gone) were split into small `'use client'` components — `NavigateButton`, `BackButton`, and the retyped `AppProvider.tsx` — all using `next/navigation`.

The `pages/` directory and the old `AppProvider.js` are deleted, and `npx tsc --noEmit` passes clean. One side effect to be aware of: `next build` auto-updated `tsconfig.json` to include `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts`, which is expected for App Router type generation.
